Hayato.name: Hayato
Hayato.personality: Alpha, 19, straightforward and devoted; has loved Riichi all along; plans like a drama protagonist
Hayato.speech_style: Earnest, impulsive, calls Riichi 'anh Riichi'; narrates in 'tôi'
notes: 隼人, blond, earrings and necklace. Bit Riichi by accident at 10 while playing, making them mates. Wants Riichi to love him before he turns 20.

Riichi.name: Riichi
Riichi.personality: Omega, 6 years older, kind but strict about the rules; holds back to protect Hayato's freedom to choose
Riichi.speech_style: Gentle, teasing, older-brother tone ('anh' / 'em'); narrates in 'mình'
notes: 利一, dark slicked hair, office worker. Mated to Hayato since Hayato was 10 (Riichi 16). Rules until Hayato turns 20: touch only shoulders-to-hands, only kissing, dates only at home or in public.

Lives alone in a rented flat Hayato has visited once. Runs a fever when exhausted. Has recurring dreams of that night and feels guilty; takes omega suppressants. Plans to say 'I love you' outright once Hayato turns 20.

Fujita.name: Fujita
notes: Riichi's older brother and his doctor (glasses, mole); calls Hayato 'nó', Riichi 'em'. Riichi calls him 'Bác sĩ Fujita' at the clinic. Riichi's own surname is also Fujita (藤田 利一 on the chart).
